description: Event registry for the Siege of Terra canon table (the Eusebian layer). Each event lists every witness: a pinned address, the narrator and narration mode, the synchronism the verse itself states, and a short quote. Disagreements between witnesses are recorded, never harmonised. Validated and rendered by scripts/canon_table.py; never a source of campaign canon.

books.author: Dan Abnett

narration_modes.first: first person; the narrator is in the scene and says I
narration_modes.second: second person; the text addresses the viewpoint character as you (Abnett's Horus verses)
narration_modes.close-third: third person limited, anchored to one character's senses
narration_modes.hearsay: the event is reported to the viewpoint character, not witnessed

events.title: Vulkan vanquishes Magnus and banishes him into the outer darkness

witnesses.synchronism: told as already accomplished; Vulkan is still in the webway with the warp behind him
witnesses.quote: Vulkan has vanquished him and banished his deathless corpse into the outer darkness

events.disagreements: Single witness; Malcador admits he does not know how many times Vulkan died doing it.

events.title: Dorn's teleport is intercepted and diverted into the desert labyrinth

witnesses.synchronism: Dorn experiences a century in the desert; the verse gives no external clock

events.disagreements: The subjective century is the only duration stated; do not convert it to siege days.

events.title: Mauer finds the Regno Kao folio in the Hall of Leng
The Emperor goes deeper into the realm of Chaos than ever before

witnesses.synchronism: none stated; Malcador on the Throne, without the lifeline of throne, beacon or path back
witnesses.quote: He has never come this close to it before.

witnesses.synchronism: none stated; Horus wanders the Court blind and calls for a light

events.disagreements: Malcador calls it the realm of Chaos where nothing retains the semblance of sense; Horus calls the same place his city and his realm. Both stand.

events.title: The death of Sanguinius

witnesses.synchronism: none stated; Horus on his knees, eviscerated, then the eighth angle
witnesses.quote: You reach along the eighth angle of space and grab.
The Angel's eyes are open, afterwards.

witnesses.narrator: Rogal Dorn, told by a companion
witnesses.synchronism: reported to Dorn while he surveys the warp-state landscape
witnesses.quote: She tells him his brother is dead.

events.disagreements: Three modes, one death: perpetrator's second person, an unanchored view of the corpse, and hearsay. No witness gives a clock; the only relative marker is the word afterwards.

events.title: The Emperor's advance lays waste to the intersectional realm and reduces a swathe of the Inevitable City to dust

witnesses.synchronism: Oll wakes in the aftermath; cold, everything bright
witnesses.quote: The divine light has ravaged the intersectional realm and left nothing standing for kilometres

witnesses.synchronism: none stated; Malcador on the Throne watching the ribbon of ash
witnesses.quote: A great swathe of the Inevitable City has been reduced to a City of Dust in his wake.

events.disagreements: Oll sees baked rubble and white ash from the ground; Malcador sees the same devastation as a charred ribbon through the city from above. Same event, two scales.

events.title: The Emperor refuses the Dark King and the discharge rolls across the transmuted realm

witnesses.synchronism: none stated; the glare spreads and begins to fade within the verse
witnesses.quote: thousands of square kilometres of the transmundane sprawl are further disintegrated to dust and ash

witnesses.synchronism: after the Dark King's shadow has gone; Dorn assesses the ground

events.disagreements: The omniscient verse measures the discharge in square kilometres; Dorn's verse gives only a tactical assessment of what is left.

events.title: Loken's group reaches the primeval heart of the Inevitable City

witnesses.synchronism: none stated; deeper into the city is deeper into its history
witnesses.quote: they are reaching the primeval heart of it

events.title: Ollanius Persson's cut through reality lands him at Horus's feet

witnesses.synchronism: none stated; Oll disorientated, soaked, on the deck
witnesses.quote: this is not the same part of the inevitable realm, or the same room. This is right at his feet.

events.title: The death of Horus Lupercal

witnesses.synchronism: the stroke itself; then the light begins to die
in the instant of his death the grip of Chaos is broken
witnesses.quote: Horus is dead, and in the instant of his death, the grip of Chaos incarnate is broken.

witnesses.synchronism: none stated; the fighting continues elsewhere

events.disagreements: Loken sees a stone knife go in; the omniscient verse names the death and its cosmological consequence; Amit has only a question and 'let's hope'. The verse itself says the end is neither the end expected nor the death foretold.

events.title: The Four withdraw and the coupled realms tear loose from Terra

witnesses.synchronism: the Inevitable City slides back over a period of eight hours
witnesses.quote: over a period of eight hours, slides back into the midnight of the empyrean like some spectral parody of old Atlantis

events.disagreements: Single witness, but the only hard duration in the sequence. Use it as the synchronism for everything that ends with the neverness.
